lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 4-5 distinct vertical white line segments visible on the torso. The central line is high-contrast and prominent, with flanking lines exhibiting lower contrast and irregular spacing toward the anterior and posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Most vertical lines terminate abruptly before reaching the ventral fringe. The line segment immediately posterior to the primary central stripe is significantly abbreviated, ending in the mid-flank region.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 3 distinct white spots of varying diameter is visible on the mid-to-lower haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the lower posterior flank align on a diagonal geometric axis sloping toward the anterior ventral region.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a lyrate/spiral trajectory, curving upward and outward from the skull base before arcing inward at the terminal points.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 3.5 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tipping occupies approximately 10-12% of the overall vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the eyes; two distinct white spots on the lower cheek; a long white dorsal mane along the spine; a dark, elongated hair fringe along the ventral neck and chest; tan-colored lower limbs featuring white patches above the hooves.
